name: Apache-Artemis
description: Apache Artemis™ is multi-protocol message broker, supporting various industry standard protocols such as AMQP 1.0, MQTT 3.1.1, MQTT 5, and STOMP. This enables users to connect from across a broad range of languages and platforms, using clients written in Java, JavaScript, C, C++, Python, .Net, and more. Artemis offers the power and flexibility to support your messaging use-case.
